title: Heather T NDE 9662
content: I remember seeing my mom and dad at my side. They were crying and holding my hands as the doctors came in. The doctors were there to provide medical assistance and get my heart pumping again. After the doctors came in. I remember turning around and I seeing a bright light behind me. The only thing I remember afterwards is waking up in my hospital room. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1980 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) I had just got out of open heat surgery and was in recovery How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I heard the conversations between my parents and the doctors, I just don't recall what was said now. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Don't recall At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Don't recall Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Don't recall Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Don't recall Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes I looked behind me and saw a bright light and walked towards it. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? I was sad that my parents were crying and sad and scared Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? No comment Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? No comment Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Don't recall Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? I was a child at the time of this occurrence Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience I don't remember much of my childhood, but I recall that moment Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I was in high school and was taking my friend, my mom asked where I heard it from because she never told anyone about the time I flat lined. I said I saw it. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Just got out of open heart surgery and was in recovery.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Observed parents and doctors while out of body; then saw a bright light behind and walked toward it; then woke up in hospital room.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported hearing conversations between parents and doctors while out of body but does not recall the content.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I clearly left my body and existed outside it.”
